text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a break in the 
cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Acute-san! Listen, listen!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"We got an offer from a TV station! They 
asked if I'd appear on a feng shui-themed 
talk show!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Aren't you amazing, Rickey-chan?
choice_data_list:
Looks like all my steady work spreading 
feng shui has finally paid off, huh.

Looks like all my steady work spreading 
feng shui has finally paid off, hasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The flow of the world is favoring feng 
shui too! If this goes well, I can spread 
the wonders of feng shui to even more 
people!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now that that's decided, I've got 
to put together what we'll discuss on the 
show! I need to make sure it's easy for 
beginners to understand!
choice_data_list: I'll help out as much as I can, too!
I'll help as much as I can too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!? Then once I'm done 
summarizing it, would you mind listening 
to it? I want you to tell me if there's 
anything you don't understand!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, fight~ Maybe I'll whip up some 
ohagi for a little snack~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yay! I looooove Acute-san's ohagi☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ I'll be sure to come see you all 
dressed up on the big day, Rickey-chan~

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
Hello~♪ Miracles happen to those who 
believe! It's time for "Destined Spiritual 
Feng Shui"! Our guest for today is this 
person!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Hello!! It's Copano 
Rickey! Let's learn lots about feng shui 
and get happyâª

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! The real deal has an even stronger 
spiritual aura~! I can totally feel the 
aura of pure bliss!

I watched the program from the stands with 
Wonder Acute. However, is it just my 
imagination, or have the words being used 
for a while now sounded rather 
questionable...

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the querent wishes to meet their 
destined one, do they? Then wear something 
pink! If I recall... that boosts your luck 
in love, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is called Color Feng 
Shui, and it's deeply connected to the 
Five Elements, the foundation of Feng 
Shui! The Five Elements are—

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me! It looks like our time is 
almost up... Er, well then, let's move on 
to the next question!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Feng shui for home arrangement can differ 
depending on the house! Using this Luopan 
compass, we can find a much more reliable 
solution."

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you gather holy power into 
that tool and make a miracle happen with a 
bang! Right? Man, this is so educational!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Looks like Rickey-chan is having 
trouble getting across what she wants to 
say~. Even her ears are drooping.
choice_data_list:
Let's cheer them on, even if it's just the 
two of us!
Let's cheer her on, even if it's just us!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Go get 'em, Rickey-chan~ 
We've got your back~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer and Acute-san are here— Right... 
I came here to spread the word about feng 
shui, so I can't chicken out now...!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um! If you'd like— would you like to try a 
Feng Shui true-or-false quiz?! They're all 
simple and super informative!!

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I like the sound of that! It'll 
totally hype up the crowd, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"You should carry as many lucky items as 
possible! True or False!?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is False! Overdoing it 
has the opposite effect☆ Next question: 
Fortunate directions and lucky colors 
change depending on the year and place! 
True or False!?

text_block_list.name: Woman in the Stands A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it was 'True' this time! This quiz is 
pretty fun. Since it's just true or false, 
the bar for entry isn't high at all!

text_block_list.name: Woman in the Stands B
text_block_list.text:
"Feng shui is a lot more grounded than I 
thought... It's got such a solid system 
behind it~. It might actually be pretty 
deep, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work, Ricky-chan. The 
audience looked like they were having a 
wonderful time~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay, awesome! I could totally see you two 
cheering for me!
choice_data_list:
Everyone really enjoyed themselves, didn't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yay, awesome! I could totally see you two 
cheering for me!
choice_data_list:
Everyone really enjoyed themselves, didn't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because the two of you gave me courage! 
Though I do have a little regret that I 
couldn't get into the deeper details...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I managed to cover pretty much all the 
basics of feng shui in the quiz! Success, 
complete success!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You really did your best~ Someday, all 
your hard work is going to pay off, 
Rickey-chan.

Saying so, Wonder Acute gently pulled 
Copano Rickey close and stroked her back 
in comfort.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you~! I'll be counting on 
both of your help again!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I won't stop! So that tomorrow is better 
than today, and the day after is even 
better, making everyone's days happier and 
happier...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. You've got this, Rickey-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And you know what, people aren't 
just talking about the show, it's trending 
on Umatter too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They said, "I think I understand feng shui 
a bit better now!" and "I hope you do the 
True/False quiz again!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That means you're definitely moving 
forward. You've worked super hard, after 
all, Rickey-chan~

Saying so, Wonder Acute gently patted 
Copano Rickey on the head.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still! Still! We've gotta make sure we 
learn from our mistakes for next time!”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Jumping straight into a full explanation 
might have set the bar too high, so I need 
to break it down into something simpler!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Aiming for Revenge! 
I'll do waaaay better next time!
